title: Lightning-quick Tuna, Chilli & Cannellini Bean Linguine
ingredients: 400g can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
200g fine green beans, cut into 2cm pieces
2 × 145g cans tuna in spring water, drained
large handful of parsley leaves, finely chopped
steps: Boil linguine; set timer for 10 minutes.
At 10 minutes, add cannellini beans and green beans; cook 3 more minutes.
Heat a frying pan with cooking spray; add garlic, sizzle 30 seconds. Add tuna, lemon juice and chilli plus 2 tbsp pasta water; stir-fry 2 minutes.
Drain linguine and beans; return to large saucepan. Add tuna mixture and half the parsley; season; mix thoroughly.
notes: Serve chilli flakes alongside for chilli-averse eaters. Wholewheat spaghetti increases fibre.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
